# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r}
library("grid")
library("upxdvir")
# options(warn = 2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
```

## Draw UpTeX Content

```{r, fig.align = "center"}
grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
grid.segments(0, .5, 1, .5, gp = gpar(lty = 2, col = "gray"))
grid.segments(.5, 0, .5, 1, gp = gpar(lty = 2, col = "gray"))
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの設定とし", verbose = FALSE)
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの設定とし", vjust = 1, x = .2, verbose = FALSE)
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの設定とし", vjust = 0, x = .8, verbose = FALSE)
```

## Cleanup

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# TODO: This chunk needs to go away some time in the future.
system2("rm", paste0(Sys.getenv("WORKSPACE"), "/upxdvir/**/file*"))
system2("rm", paste0(Sys.getenv("WORKSPACE"), "/upxdvir/file*"))
```
